slides.label: Verse 1
lines: What were once considered distant prophecies
Are becoming daily happenings and headlines
The safest place to be is in the truth of God’s word

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: The world is aligning with ancient prophecies
By the prophets of God, the day is almost over,

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: And the end of the age is near
All manner of falsehood and deceptions
Are in the world
As the Bible says would be in these last days

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: But in all of these, we hold strong
To God’s eternal truth
The Gospel of our Lord Jesus

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Fearless, courageous, we stand strong
With our conviction sealed with the blood
of the Lamb

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: Who was made the perfect sacrifice for sins
With great joy, we look to Your coming

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Lord Jesus in You, we stand strong
Above death and hell forever
Your Word lives on when all is gone

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: The darker the night, the brighter our lights shine
The end of the age is near,
And all the signs are clear

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: Where fear rules, our faith is stronger
Your Word prevails, our voice is bolder
Our hope stands till the day You return

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: In every battle, our victory is sure
The fiercer the fight, the stronger
We stand in Your name

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: And Your Word is our anchor forever
Lord Jesus, the Way, The Truth and Life

slides.label: Verse 12
lines: Hallelujah, we stand in Your name
Hallelujah, we advance in victory
Hallelujah, we live in Your name
Hallelujah, we have the victory

slides.label: Verse 13
lines: Hallelujah, we stand in Your name
Hallelujah, we advance in victory
Hallelujah, we live in Your name
Hallelujah, we have the victory

slides.label: Verse 14
lines: Lord Jesus in You, we stand strong
Above death and hell forever
Your Word lives on when all is gone

slides.label: Verse 15
lines: The darker the night, the brighter our lights shine
The end of the age is near,
Our hope stands till the day You return
